name: matchup_opponent_type combined with year_offset
description: Crosses the inline matchup branch (matchup_opponent_type) with year_offset behavior on a team-stats-from-plays column. Coverage gap (d).
expected_query: with "current_week_opponents" as (select "home_nfl_team" as "nfl_team", "away_nfl_team" as "opponent" from "public"."nfl_games" where "season_year" = 2026 and "week" = 7 and "season_type" = 'REG' union select "away_nfl_team" as "nfl_team", "home_nfl_team" as "opponent" from "public"."nfl_games" where "season_year" = 2026 and "week" = 7 and "season_type" = 'REG'), "t4071c168eead75a246864903074b5ad1" as materialized (select "nfl_plays"."offense_nfl_team" as "nfl_team", SUM(pass_yards) AS team_pass_yds_from_plays from "nfl_plays" where "play_type" in ('PASS', 'RUSH', 'KOFF', 'PUNT', 'FGXP', 'FREE') and "nfl_plays"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_plays"."season_year" in (2023, 2024) group by "nfl_plays"."offense_nfl_team"), "t4071c168eead75a246864903074b5ad1_team_stats" as materialized (select "t4071c168eead75a246864903074b5ad1"."nfl_team", sum(t4071c168eead75a246864903074b5ad1.team_pass_yds_from_plays) as team_pass_yds_from_plays from "t4071c168eead75a246864903074b5ad1" group by "t4071c168eead75a246864903074b5ad1"."nfl_team") select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, (SELECT SUM(t4071c168eead75a246864903074b5ad1_team_stats.team_pass_yds_from_plays) FROM t4071c168eead75a246864903074b5ad1_team_stats WHERE t4071c168eead75a246864903074b5ad1_team_stats.nfl_team = current_week_opponents.opponent) AS "team_pass_yds_from_plays_0", "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "current_week_opponents" on "player"."current_nfl_team" = "current_week_opponents"."nfl_team" group by "current_week_opponents"."opponent", player.first_name, player.last_name, "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 500
